body:
### Which @angular/* package(s) are the source of the bug?

compiler-cli

### Is this a regression?

No

### Description


origin code
```ts
@Injectable({
  useFactory: (a) => new AppService(a),
  providedIn: 'root',
  deps: [[new Optional(), 'aa']],
})
export class AppService {
  constructor(aa) {}
}

```
compile code
```ts
class AppService {
    constructor(aa) { }
}
AppService.ɵfac = function AppService_Factory(t) { _angular_core__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["ɵɵinvalidFactory"](); };
AppService.ɵprov = /*@__PURE__*/ _angular_core__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["ɵɵdefineInjectable"]({ token: AppService, factory: function AppService_Factory(t) { let r = null; if (t) {
        r = new t();
    }
    else {
        r = ((a) => new AppService(a))(_angular_core__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__["ɵɵinject"]([new _angular_core__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__.Optional(), 'aa'], 8));
    } return r; }, providedIn: 'root' });
```

And When I run without `new Optional()` the code must throw error
I guess  in `ɵprov` member, `factory` use ɵɵinject not remove decorator instance so make error
